entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A draconic planeswalker and member of Urza's Nine Titans whose betrayal Urza predicted and used to engineer Phyrexia's demise.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who recruited the Nine Titans and predicted Tevesh Szat's betrayal.

entities.name: Urza's Nine Titans
entities.description: A band of powerful planeswalkers recruited to destroy Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane the Nine Titans were recruited to destroy.

events.summary: Urza predicts Tevesh Szat's betrayal and uses the planeswalker's life to engineer Phyrexia's demise.
events.quote: Urza predicted Tevesh Szat’s eventual betrayal, using the draconic Planeswalker’s life to engineer Phyrexia’s demise.

relations.quote: Tevesh Szat was a member of Urza’s Nine Titans
